third_party_evaluations.summary: Hands-on entry-level network pentest; widely respected practical alternative to Security+.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 3. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Practical entry network testing supplies a technical security foundation at zero experience; recorded junior scope and limited hiring recognition do not establish independent professional assessment responsibility.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: A hands-on entry network-pentest exam provides credible foundational offensive skills. Zero experience and the explicit limited entry hiring signal prevent treating it as evidence of independent engagement delivery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded hands-on network pentest validates meaningful entry technical skills with no experience requirement. Its junior scope and limited hiring signal keep it foundational rather than upgrading it solely for practical format.
